name: Corn Dolly

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (a curved blade plated in gold); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Husk Body
traits.summary: Squeezes through gaps an inch wide at no extra cost.
traits.text: The corn dolly moves through spaces as narrow as an inch without paying extra movement.

traits.name: Uneasy Visage
traits.summary: While someone holds it, creatures within 10 ft have Disadvantage on Insight checks against the holder.
traits.text: Its painted face unsettles onlookers: while a creature is holding the corn dolly, creatures within 10 feet have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made against that creature.

actions.name: Blank Stare
actions.summary: One creature it sees within 30 ft: DC 13 Wis save or 3d6 Psychic (half on a success).

actions.name: Sowing Dread
actions.summary: Twice a day: 15-ft cone, creatures of its choice make a DC 13 Wis save or are Frightened until the end of their next turn.

reactions.name: Silent Protector
reactions.trigger: A creature within 60 ft fails a saving throw against an effect that deals no damage.
reactions.summary: Recharges on a Short or Long Rest. When a creature within 60 ft fails a save against an effect that does no damage, the dolly suffers the effect instead.

summary: A husk doll that guards its holder: it cuts and stares with psychic dread, scares groups, and takes an ally's failed save on itself.
